# Vyapar Setu — Raw Data Directory
# This folder contains CSV files generated by services/data_pipeline.py
#
# Files generated:
#   freight_rates.csv      — Weekly freight rates + all features (2020-2024)
#   bdi_series.csv         — Baltic Dry Index weekly (BPI-5TC, BCI-5TC)
#   bunker_prices.csv      — VLSFO Singapore weekly prices
#   usd_inr.csv            — USD/INR weekly exchange rate
#   cyclone_records.csv    — Bay of Bengal cyclone events
#
# To generate:
#   cd website/backend
#   python services/data_pipeline.py
